title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, and Claude gets a personal finance feature
excerpt: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber and a new data-centre policy framework, Anthropic rolled out a personal finance feature for Claude, and The Economist questioned OpenAI's approach to mathematics.

items.t: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, describing it as advancing the frontier of "aligned cybersecurity agents".

items.h: Anthropic rolls out a personal finance feature for Claude
items.t: Reuters reported that Anthropic rolled out a personal finance feature for Claude. Before connecting any financial account to an AI tool, check exactly what it can see and do, and whether it can move money.

items.h: OpenAI lays out a policy framework for data centres
items.t: Politico reported that OpenAI laid out a new policy framework for data centres, and OpenAI published "Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure". Data centres need power and water, which is why they matter for countries like Nigeria that want to host them.

items.h: The Economist: 'OpenAI's approach to mathematics does not add up'
items.t: The Economist published a critical look at OpenAI's approach to mathematics, following earlier doubts about a headline maths claim.

water.h: Chip design as an investor pitch
water.t: Yahoo Finance reported that Anthropic is touting Claude's chip design skills to investors ahead of its IPO, and Noahpinion argued that "Anthropic's moat is Claude". Investor-pitch chatter and one writer's opinion.

means.t: AI can help you budget, but never share bank logins, card numbers or PINs in a chat. Use rough figures and categories instead.
AI for money tasks is best for organising and explaining: cash-flow tables, invoice reminders, price tests. Keep the final decisions and accounting records with you or your accountant.
A maths or science claim from an AI company is a claim, not a proof. Wait for independent experts to check it.

prompt: Help me review my monthly money without sharing any account details. My rough monthly income is [amount] and spending by category is [list with rough amounts]. Show a simple budget table, the three biggest leaks, one saving goal, and a five-line monthly review checklist. Do not ask for account numbers.
